title: confed whoami result
description: The `result` of `confed whoami --json`: who the stored credentials authenticate as, and what this server can do.

server_version.description: Product version, e.g. "9.5.4". Data Center reports it; Cloud does not.

inline_comment_create.description: False on Data Center, which has no inline comment API. Attempting it exits 9.

adf.description: Whether the server speaks Atlassian Document Format.

move_between_spaces.description: Whether `confed instance mv` can move pages here, asked about a page of this workspace with a target that cannot exist, so nothing moves. `available`: the REST move endpoint answers. `web_action`: Data Center without it; confed moves through the web UI's move action (not a documented API) and reads each move back. `unavailable`: neither, or the web action does not accept this credential; `confed instance mv` exits 9. `unknown`: no pulled page to ask about, or an unclear answer.
